# Level 6 — Senior Backend Engineer — Grade A (Technical leadership)

**Audience:** Senior engineers leading cross-team work.

**Graduation outcome:** Shapes the technical direction of a major product area, resolves difficult architectural problems, establishes engineering standards, and influences several teams without formal authority.

## Capstone — Multi-Year Platform Evolution (`SRA-CAP`)

Three-year architecture evolution strategy for a growing commerce platform: capacity assumptions, modernization sequencing, security and reliability objectives, cost estimates, and governance.

**Graduation gate:** Strategy defense before a simulated leadership panel.

See [`projects/ladder.md`](../../projects/ladder.md) for the full brief and [`assessment/framework.md`](../../assessment/framework.md) for grading.
